The executed case in tests/src/browser/IndexedDBCursor.test.ts asserts only errorCode(onSeek) === 'UNKNOWN', and tests/guides.test.ts binds the native-name clause with a substring guard alone. The residual — a change to a different unmapped name — is unguarded. Exact closing edit if the Orchestrator wants it: in that same case, capture onSeek.cause behind isIndexedDBError(onSeek), assert it is a DOMException, read its name, and align all three prose sites to whatever Chromium reports. Raised as a referral rather than a finding because the round-1 lane's own prescription named the executed case alone; re-opening it one grain finer is the repeating frame rather than a new defect.
